The '''nano-stars''' were [[Silentium]] embryos inhabiting the [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].

==Characteristics==
The nano-stars were embryo versions of the [[Silentium]].<ref name="Blogs" /> Each star was flat and pentagonal in shape, half a meter in diameter. From each of the star's five corners five small metallic tentacles appeared, although they were not used for movement; nano-stars propelled themselves through water with a number of flexible screws. Their microcircuitry was water-sealed.<ref name="Geonosis" />

Nano-stars did not appear to eat. They protected themselves by zapping an electric current through water if they felt threatened. Nano-stars were assumed to be able to construct new nano-stars, although this process was never witnessed. Several million nano-stars were believed to exist in the [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="Geonosis" />

==History==
Mon Calamari boaters near [[Foamwander City]] saw a colossal metallic sphere descend from the sky, drop something in the ocean, and then vanish again. Soon afterwards, fish-catchers began finding nano-stars in the seas of Mon Calamari.<ref name="Geonosis" />

==Behind the scenes==
In his endnotes for ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]] confirmed that the nano-stars were "embryo versions of Vuffi's species."<ref name="Blogs" />
